description: Follows the postwar expatriates and the fiesta, examining restraint, injury, gender, money, and the meanings of apparent freedom. Covers Story I: Paris and an Unspoken Wound; Story II: Fishing and the Road to Pamplona; Story III: Fiesta, Violence, and Madrid; The Sun Also Rises: The Lost Generation and Literary Influence.
